title: Congress expels DCC member Suhail Shajahan from primary membership after arrest in extortion case
description: Thiruvananthapuram DCC member Shajahan was arrested by Pettah police after allegedly demanding ₹10 lakh from the complainant, Dr. Sabine Sivadasan, owner of a private hospital, in exchange for not circulating a fabricated defamatory content on WhatsApp groups and YouTube channels
